note: exploratory recurrence readout; definitions and the reading rule fixed in docs/plan.md ('Recurrence readout (fixed 2026-09-30, before computing)') before computing; descriptive, no significance claims

definitions.window: consecutive deep censuses (every 1,000 steps) with role share >= 5% spanning >= 1e5 steps
definitions.fill: first window of a role in a run; atStart = begins at step 100; late = begins at step >= 2e5
definitions.postFillEvent: window k>=2 starting at step >= 2e5 that is a return (gap from previous window >= 1e5 steps) or a replacement (gap < 1e5 and the holder clade has not held an earlier window of the role)
definitions.clade: founder lineage reached by walking mutations.tsv parents; clones with identical founder genomes share a clade
definitions.statistic: events per run (and per 1e5 steps = / 8), percentile bootstrap over runs, 5000 resamples, 90% interval (5th-95th)

primaryReading.stratum: C counting sets pooled (S1+S5), uniform garden

strata.stratum: C counting sets pooled (S1+S5), uniform garden

countingVsNonCountingC.note: (mutation - no-mutation) post-fill events per run in S1+S5 minus the same in S2+S4

cloudsVsPointFounders.note: returns only (replacement cannot exist for a point founder); B clouds against the solo runs of the same 12 founders, pooled, balanced; (mutation - no-mutation) in B minus the same in solo

barForStep1.rule: S6 shows more than one-shot filling only if (a) mutation-arm post-fill events per run exceed its no-mutation arm with the 90% interval of the difference excluding zero; (b) >= 3 of 5 mutation runs have >= 1 post-fill event; (c) the S6 mutation-arm mean exceeds the largest mutation-arm mean among the pooled strata (B clouds, point founders, S1+S5 pool); (d) its producer-only and obligate-only mutation controls show fewer post-fill events per run than S6
